::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/products"}
#docs
`?kind=plan` is a flat shorthand for the `kind` filter below (a parameter name can only be declared once, so it is described here); the bracketed form `?<field>[is]=` works too.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_archived` | `boolean` | no | Set to `true` to also list archived products. |
| `group` | `string` | no | Filter by product group public id |
| `status` | `string` | no | Filter by the product's status. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Opt-in paging. Without `limit` or `starting_after` every matching row is returned as `{ object, data }`; `q`, `sort_by` and `field[op]` filters apply either way. With either, the response is one page with `has_more`, `next_cursor` and `total` (`limit` defaults to 50). |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous next_cursor |
| `offset` | `string` | no | The previous page's next_offset — the same token as next_cursor under a second name. Pass one of offset or starting_after, not two different values. |
| `q` | `string` | no | Matches id, name or external name |
| `sort_by[asc]` | `string` | no | Sort ascending by this field. |
| `sort_by[desc]` | `string` | no | Sort descending by this field. |
| `id` | `object` | no | Filter on `id`. Send as `id[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `name` | `object` | no | Filter on `name`. Send as `name[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `external_name` | `object` | no | Filter on `external_name`. Send as `external_name[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `kind` | `object` | no | Filter on `kind`. Send as `kind[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `product_group` | `object` | no | Filter by the product group's id (a slug id, e.g. `default`). |
| `metered` | `object` | no | Filter on `metered`. Send as `metered[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `enabled_for_checkout` | `object` | no | Filter on `enabled_for_checkout`. Send as `enabled_for_checkout[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `enabled_in_portal` | `object` | no | Filter on `enabled_in_portal`. Send as `enabled_in_portal[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `active` | `object` | no | Filter on `active`. Send as `active[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `created_at` | `object` | no | Filter on `created_at`. Send as `created_at[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `updated_at` | `object` | no | Filter on `updated_at`. Send as `updated_at[<operator>]=<value>`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.tax_code` | `string` | HSN/SAC classification (India GST). Falls back to the business default_tax_code when null. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The product's id (`pro`). |
| `data.product_group` | `string` | The id of the product group this product is in (a slug id, e.g. `default`), or null. |
| `data.kind` | `string` | Whether the product is a plan, an addon or a one-time charge. One of `plan`, `addon`, `charge`. |
| `data.code` | `string` | The product's code, unique within the business. |
| `data.name` | `string` | The product's name. |
| `data.description` | `string` | The product's description. |
| `data.image_url` | `string` | The product's image. Set with `POST …/products/{prod}/image`. |
| `data.enabled_for_checkout` | `boolean` | Stored only: no checkout reads it yet, so it changes nothing. |
| `data.enabled_in_portal` | `boolean` | Stored only: the customer portal does not read it yet, so it changes nothing. |
| `data.redirect_url` | `string` | Where hosted checkout sends the buyer after paying, when the checkout or payment link names no redirect of its own (the plan's product, else the first item's). javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file: and blob: are refused. Send "" to clear. |
| `data.addon_applies_to_all` | `boolean` | For an addon: true if it can attach to every plan. |
| `data.active` | `boolean` | True if the product is active. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/products?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "product",
      "id": "pro",
      "product_group": "default",
      "kind": "plan",
      "name": "Pro",
      "active": false
    }
  ]
}
```
